warnings: Pedestal (ตอม่อ) box spec is identical to the normal (non-seismic) column table on S-05: 0.20x0.20m, 4-Ø12mm. The seismic override here is the stirrup spacing along C1's continuing floor-level column, printed '@VARIES' instead of a fixed spacing — detailed on this same sheet's column-rebar-spacing drawing (below the table) as a tightened zone (Ø6mm@0.10m for 0.60m near each end, Ø6mm@0.15m mid-height, over the pedestal+floor-column run of roughly 0.60+1.80+3.00+0.60m).
This sheet's own note recommends using this S-10 detail for seismic zones 1 and 2 (province lists transcribed in the companion notes file, _view2_notes_seismic12.json).
